note: Header fields are read directly from the input file and control later allocation and scanline processing.
The implementation should ensure the row-count multiplication is valid before using it to size RLE tables; that safety obligation is violated when dimensions are malformed.
The computed row count is used directly as an allocation size for the RLE offset table.
The truncated file leaves the RLE length table unread, so the parser consumes invalid data and fails while trusting the computed row count.
